nftBody: Every verified person who joins before mainnet receives a Founder NFT with their public number. Getting it is free. The record is written into the genesis block and stays there — there will never be a second genesis.
nftBullets: Free for verified founders before mainnet
Your number is part of chain history from day one
Same base rights for every founder — special numbers add small one-time perks only
tiersSub: Your tier follows the order you verified. Inside each tier, your exact number is assigned by a fair public random draw when that tier closes — nobody chooses their number.

specialBody: Some numbers stand out: round or visually distinctive numbers, and the last number in each tier. The last number in a tier is not given to whoever joined last — it is drawn fairly among everyone in that tier.
specialList: The last number of each tier
specialFixedNote: This list is published and fixed before registration opens. It will not change afterwards, so everyone can check the draw was fair.
specialPerksTitle: What a special number gets — once
specialPerksBody: Every special number gets the same one-time bonus. It is a thank-you, not money: no payouts, no price promises, no permanent discounts. Base founder rights stay the same for everyone.
sealBody: When the founder window closes, PEOPLE will hold a public sealing ceremony for the genesis block. Founder names that opted into the public mosaic will appear together as a permanent snapshot of who started the network.
mosaicSub: A visual mosaic of founder names will go live at sealing. Search by handle is coming then.
mosaicSearchHint: Handle search opens when the genesis block is sealed.

faq.a: Yes. Verification with Human Passport on PEOPLE is free, and your Founder NFT is free before mainnet.

faq.q: Can I pick my founder number?
faq.a: No. Numbers are tied to your tier and assigned by a fair public random draw within that tier. Nobody can reserve a favourite number.

faq.q: Are there payouts or guaranteed rewards?
faq.a: No. This page is about identity and history in the genesis block, not payouts or investment returns.
Sign in on PEOPLE, complete Human Passport verification, and follow the steps on this page. Use the Verify section below when you are ready.
PEOPLE is a community blockchain — created by people, for the community. Founders are verified humans who join before mainnet.

finalSub: Verify with Human Passport, claim your place among the Million Founders, and keep your number in the genesis block forever.
specialPerks: An animated frame and badge on your Founder NFT

7 days of early access to new PEOPLE features and drops
specialNamedBadge: #1 and the last number of each tier also get their own named badge.
